messages:
mike_sales: FYI, CieloHealth POC blocked. CTO (Asha) won't sign off until we confirm SSO SAML flow + clarify pricing delta for reserved GPU capacity vs burst. They're also pushing security questionnaire answers. Need an exec-level contact before EOD.

ana_presales: looping in @carlos_ceo and @jess_prod. Quick ask — can we provide a short doc that explains reserved vs burst pricing with example cost for 10M tokens/day?

ellie_security: I've uploaded the answered sec-quest (link: https://redwood.internal/sec/cielo-answers). Major callouts: data residency EU-only, KMS BYO requested, and 3rd-party pen test report needed. CISO will want encryption-at-rest attestation.

raj_sre: For the POC throughput, reserved pool ok but we'll need to guarantee warm instances for steady 500 rps. If they want burst to 2k we should recommend dedicated burst nodes; that changes the SLA and price.

jess_prod: Feature gating: we can enable an allowlist + SAML mapping to teams. Need mapping details from their IdP. Quick example config we can give:
```
SAML: {
  entity_id: "https://redwood.app/saml",
  acs: "https://redwood.app/saml/acs",
  attributeMappings: { 'email'->'user.email', 'groups'->'user.groups' }
}
```

mike_sales: The CTO is asking for an exec call — can we get a 30m slot w/ @carlos_ceo + @ellie_security today? They want to finalize buy decision Friday.

carlos_ceo: I can join 1600 PT. Need 2-slide TL;DR: (1) pricing delta + example numbers, (2) security commitments (KMS, SSO, SOC2 scope). Ana, can you own slides?

ana_presales: On it. I'll draft slides and post in next hour. Also preparing cost table with reserved monthly vs usage-basis.

ellie_security: I'll prepare a 1-page security summary and attach artifact list (SOC2 cert, pen test, KMS workflow). Also confirm we can support BYO-KMS for the POC in EU region — tagging @raj_sre for feasibility.

raj_sre: BYO-KMS in EU is doable but needs a short network config: they must open outbound to kms.redwood-eu.example.com:443 and we need a one-time cert exchange. Opsbot will post the runbook.

opsbot: Runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cielo-poc-kms. Steps: 1) cert exchange, 2) IP allowlist, 3) test handshake. Contact oncall: raj_sre.

mike_sales: Great. Next steps: ana slides + ellie sec summary + ops runbook link. Carlos confirmed 1600 PT for exec call. I'll prep meeting invite and include Asha (CTO) + their CISO.

jess_prod: Also flag: if they enable streaming with 16k context the cost/throughput changes — add that scenario to pricing doc.

ana_presales: Noted. Will include streaming/16k and 8k comparison.

carlos_ceo: Thanks team. If we get these artifacts before 1500 PT, I'll review slides and join call prep. :thumbsup: 

mike_sales: will update thread with invite and artifacts. Thanks everyone.
